concepts.name: The Green Hour
concepts.tagline: Organic small plates, market-fresh produce and a bar that keeps late hours.
concepts.description: Proposed for Vegan restaurant in Vienna, Austria. A design-led format proposed from the returned reference places, where the physical expression carries the brand and the programming follows the space. These places were returned for the query; their design quality was not independently assessed. It was returned by Qloo for a Vienna, Austria query; the location it belongs to was not verified.

Under Phillips' direction, The Tallis Scholars have significantly contributed to the revival and appreciation of early choral music worldwide.

evidence.description: Come on Children (1973), directed by Allan King and filmed in Canada, is an observational documentary that follows ten teenagers living together on a farmhouse as they adjust to communal life. Featuring Alan Dunikowsky, Ken Gibbs, and John Hamilton, the film records their music, conversations, minor conflicts, drug use, and encounters with family visitors. More portrait than plot-driven narrative, it examines adolescence, alienation, and identity through quiet, candid scenes that emphasize authenticity over dramatization. The emotional tone is reflective and gently probing, offering a nostalgic yet unsentimental snapshot of youth.
